name: Mullumbimby Access Point
summary: Regional northern-NSW ISP (Mullumbimby Access Point Pty Ltd, ACN 078 688 418, ABN 67 078 688 418, Mullumbimby NSW 2482). Three 1997 IP-index allocations (MULLUMBIMBYACCE-AU 203.35.138.0/24, MULLUMBIMBYACCE1-AU 203.35.225.0/24, TIG-MULLUM-1 203.109.168.0/23) - the TIG netname places it on The Internet Group (ihug predecessor) network. A registered Pty Ltd holding /24 allocations on a carrier network indicates a dial-up ISP operation, NOT a net cafe. Business names: MAPIT (2001-2004), later Shelly Beach Cafe (2006-2010). ABN active 2000 - cancelled 16 Apr 2015.
